introHtml: EMT lapel pins are a distinctive way to honor emergency medical service professionals, whether for department insignia, memorials, or trade show giveaways. Sourced from supplier EMT, these custom pins offer sharp detail in soft enamel or printed finishes, with options like 1-inch or 1.5-inch sizes. Perfect for EMS agencies, police, and fire departments looking to recognize service or promote team unity.
